chunks: “If you do not know whether you have prayed four or five, or whether you have decreased or increased, then recite the tashahhud, say the salam, and perform two sajdahs without ruku' and without recitation; you recite in them a light tashahhud.” As for the recommended words to be said in these two sajdahs:
(773) 74. Among what he narrated: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Abi Jaʿfar, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from ʿUbayd Allah al-Halabi, who said:

I heard Aba ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام say regarding the two sajdahs of forgetfulness: “In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and may Allah bless Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad.” He said: And I heard him on another occasion say in them: “In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.”

Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Whoever leaves one prayer from the five, deliberately or forgetfully, and does not know which one it is, should pray four rakʿahs, three rakʿahs, and two rakʿahs. What indicates that is what he narrated:

key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَبِاللَّهِ: an opening devotional formula recited in sajdatay al-sahw
key_terms.بِغَيْرِ رُكُوعٍ: without performing bowing in these prostrations
key_terms.تَشَهَّدْ: recite the tashahhud before concluding the prayer
key_terms.تَشَهُّدًا خَفِيفًا: a brief tashahhud recited in the two sajdahs
key_terms.سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ: the two prostrations performed for forgetfulness in salat
key_terms.سَلِّمْ: say the salam to complete the prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةً مِنَ الْخَمْسِ: one of the five daily prayers

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in sajdatay al-sahw, and what should one do if unsure about an addition or omission in salat?
ai.summary: This passage discusses the ruling of doubt in salat, specifically when a person is unsure whether they have added to or omitted from the prayer, and it instructs performing sajdatay al-sahw after tashahhud and salam. It also transmits recommended formulas to recite in the two sajdahs of forgetfulness and includes a legal note about making up an unknown missed daily prayer.
